subject: Prompt harvest schedule & evaluation owner alignment for Brightlane trial
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Zhang <emma@brightlanehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prompt harvest schedule & evaluation owner alignment for Brightlane trial

Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment as you start gathering logs: 

Call recap (short):
- Goal: 6-week evaluation to validate answer quality and latency for Brightlane's internal clinical QA workflows.
- Success criteria we discussed: accuracy / factuality, latency targets, and low hallucination for patient-facing responses.

Proposed concrete success metrics (please confirm):
1) Weighted answer accuracy >= 88% on the seeded/annotated set (weights: clinical-critical prompts 60%, triage prompts 40%).
2) Latency p50 <= 400ms, p95 <= 1200ms on the trial hardware profile.
3) Hallucination rate < 5% on blind eval.

Data we need from Brightlane for the POC evaluation:
- Prompt bundle: 1,000 representative queries (CSV). Minimum: 500 production queries + 100 edge-case/rare queries + 400 sampled across product verticals.
- Each row should include: id, user_query, optional context (redacted), expected_answer (if available), severity_tag (clinical/triage/admin), and a sensitive_flag (yes/no).
- File format: UTF-8 CSV or JSONL. If PHI is present, please pseudonymize before sending and include a short note describing the method.

Timeline (proposed):
- By 2028-06-02: Brightlane delivers raw prompt bundle + sample annotation guide + any redaction notes.
- By 2028-06-09: Redwood delivers evaluation harness + data validation report + initial QC of bundle.
- By 2028-06-16: First evaluation run complete and readout call (decision checkpoint).

Ownership (R = Redwood, B = Brightlane):
- Raw logs & annotation guide: B (Emma + data team)
- Pseudonymization / redaction: B (with optional Redwood script)
- Ingest + validation + QC: R (Ben)
- Eval rubric + threshold tuning: R (Monica)
- Readout & commercial next steps: R/B shared (Maya + Emma)

Security / paperwork: if you need a DPA or temporary NDA addendum before data transfer, loop in your legal/security contact and I'll escalate to our compliance team.

Attachments: I attached a one-page proposal stub (redwood-proposal-stub.xlsx) with the trial milestones and a suggested resource plan.

Please reply with any edits to the metrics/timeline and confirm who on your side will own delivery. If the timeline above works, we can schedule a 30-min intake next Wednesday to walk through the CSV schema and redaction approach.

Thanks —
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
maya@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

[Attachment: redwood-proposal-stub.xlsx]

From: Emma Zhang <emma@brightlanehealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prompt harvest schedule & evaluation owner alignment for Brightlane trial

Thanks Maya — this looks great and aligns with our expectations. Confirming: Brightlane will own the raw exports and pseudonymization. I am the primary POC and I'll add our data lead (cc'd on the secure send) for the delivery.

Notes: 
- We can deliver an initial sample (250 queries, mixed severity) by 2028-05-30, and the full 1,000 bundle by 2028-06-02.
- We prefer JSONL; we'll include the fields you requested.
- We'll attach a short data handling requirements PDF that lists what we can share and what must be redacted.

Attached for your intake: brightlane_prompt_sample.csv (250-row sample) and data_handling_requirements.pdf.

I'll coordinate with our security team if a DPA addendum is needed, but I don't expect blockers.

Best,
Emma Zhang
Head of Data Integrations, Brightlane Health
emma@brightlanehealth.com

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Brightlane prompt harvest — task split and short checklist

Ben / Monica — quick internal split based on Emma's note (she's sending a 250-sample today and full bundle by 6/2):

Ben — can you own the ingest pipeline and data validation checklist? Specific asks:
- Stand up the ingestion S3 staging and schema validator (CSV/JSONL) by 2028-05-26.
- Provide a validation report template (missing fields, suspicious tokens, size distribution).
- Run a first pass on the 250-sample when Emma sends it and flag any PHI/non-compliant fields.

Monica — please prepare the evaluation harness & rubric:
- Draft eval rubric with weighted metrics (accuracy, hallucination, latency) by 2028-05-29.
- Provide labeling guidelines for clinical-critical prompts and an example annotation UI or instructions for our QA annotators.
- Identify top 20 edge-case queries from sample for targeted tests.

I'll schedule a 30-min intake for 2028-05-31 at 10:00 AM PT with Emma to walk through the field mapping and redaction approach — calendar invite to follow.

Maya

I'll draft a recommended pseudonymization example and attach it to the intake doc.
